title: Cure Francis's affliction
summary: Aboleth ichor clings to Francis. He can't rest, only magical healing works, and the acid pain keeps coming back.

objectives.text: Get Sister Garaele's clergy findings (expected 2–4 nights after session 37)
Vexhar copies the Remove Curse scroll (6 hrs, 150 gp, DC 13, then a day to prepare it)

title: Sit down with the Harpers
summary: The Harpers have taken an interest in the party and want to talk with Francis about joining or working alongside them. Francis agreed to meet. Keep Garaele's secret.

title: Phandalin's festival
summary: About halfway through. Tickets so far: Broc leads, then Levon, Allyanna, Vexhar, Francis and Blue.

objectives.text: Madame Vane's riddles and card reading
Archery vs. Phelan the Red (Broc tied)

title: Restore Tresendar Manor as the party's bastion
summary: The town gave the party the deed and pays for structural work. Torra Ironwell is building personalized rooms.

objectives.text: Pay 150 gp for personalized rooms (woodshop, bar, training room, musician's study, alchemist study, sunroom)
Find what's damaging the drains (the aboleth)
Furnish with the Realm stock wood Torra found

title: Clear the undead from the Forge of Spells
summary: Four zombies and a ghoul drove Vexhar out of the forge. Vexhar's papers were left behind. The plan is for Craig's goblin commune to clear them as good public relations.

objectives.text: Get word to Craig (letter handed to Sildar)

title: Restore the Forge of Spells
summary: The forge lends magic drawn from the cave. Its floor channels were built for a much stronger flow, and it runs at about a quarter of its potential. Enchantments last about 8 hours.

objectives.text: Research the forge (Vexhar and Francis have research points)

reward: 10% of Wave Echo Cave's profits once it's running

title: Set up Craig's goblins as mine guards
summary: The party proposed that Craig's goblin commune, and a bugbear, could guard Wave Echo Cave. Gundren agreed and said he'll pay the goblins a flat percentage himself, without touching the party's 10%. The party answers for any trouble they cause.

objectives.text: Get word to Craig (Broc's letter; Toblen's carrier couldn't promise delivery)
Craig's goblins agree and arrive at the mine

reward: Good standing for the goblins in Phandalin

title: The bugbear captain's parole
summary: Instead of killing the bugbear captain in Wave Echo Cave, Francis and Blue let him go on a promise: he travels to Craig's goblin commune and helps protect it, using Craig as a reference. A faked illusion mark keeps him honest.

objectives.text: Confirm he reached Craig's commune and kept his word

title: Tell Gundren that Elmina was worried
summary: At Barthen's Provisions, Elmina asked the party to let Gundren know she was worried about him if they found him. The party promised they wouldn't leave him out there alone. Gundren is home now, but the notes never mention passing her message on.

title: Mirna's heirloom in Thundertree
summary: Mirna Dendrar's family hid an heirloom in Thundertree. She'll reward its return.

objectives.text: Travel to Thundertree and recover the heirloom

title: Hamun Kost's standing trade
summary: Hamun will trade arcane insight for discoveries about Bowgentle's spellbook or the necromancer. His own question for Agatha was never asked.

objectives.text: Bring Hamun news of the spellbook or the necromancer

title: Get Glasstaff's letters to Sildar
summary: Sildar asked to see the letters recovered from Glasstaff's chambers, but Caine took the correspondence with him when he left for his monastery.

objectives.text: Get the letters back from Caine

title: The owlbear cubs' cave
summary: The party killed an owlbear by the bridge on the road to Wyvern Tor. Its cubs stayed in the cave nearby, and the party never went back to check on them.

title: Give Tharden a proper burial
summary: Buried in Phandalin's cemetery under Levon's marker, which Levon promised to maintain.

title: Investigate Tresendar Manor's drains
summary: The pipe damage was an aboleth, which the party killed. It left Francis afflicted and Blue with the Drowned Pan Flute.

title: Reclaim Wave Echo Cave and find Gundren's brothers
summary: Tharden was found dead, Nundro was rescued, Nezznar was killed and the spectator released.

title: Rescue Gundren from Cragmaw Castle
summary: Found beaten and unconscious in King Grol's chamber.

title: Deal with the Redbrands
summary: Cleared the hideout under Tresendar Manor and killed Glasstaff.

title: Find Iarno Albrek
summary: Iarno was Glasstaff. Sildar paid anyway.

title: Drive off the Wyvern Tor marauders
summary: Fought bugbears, an ogre and an orc. Caine was taken hostage, freed, and then left the party.

title: Ask Agatha about Bowgentle's spellbook
summary: Agatha traded the book to someone "of Erebor" over a century ago.

title: Clear the goblin cave near Old Owl Well
summary: It turned out to be Glasstaff's hideout, with Blue and Allyanna in its cells.
reward: 60 gp 15 sp and a scroll of Darkness

title: Return the Lion's Shield crates
summary: Recovered from Klarg's cave.

title: Rescue Sildar and deliver Gundren's supplies
summary: Saved Sildar from Yeemik, killed Klarg and delivered the wagon to Barthen's.
reward: 50 gp from Sildar plus delivery pay

title: Get Harbin to act on the Redbrands
summary: Lenine offered a standing discount if the party could get Townmaster Harbin Wester to deal with the Redbrands. They ended up wiping the Redbrands out themselves, and Francis negotiated the discount when they reported back.
reward: 50 gp, then 25 gp traded for a standing 10% discount

title: Rescue Caine at Wyvern Tor
summary: An orc dragged Caine into the cave at Wyvern Tor and held him at crossbow point. The party got him back, and right after being freed Caine left to help rebuild his monastery.

title: Levon's debt to the tree
summary: He took wood from a forbidden part of the forest. His eyes are changing, the carved sapling's pattern appeared in Choppy, and Choppy is now +1.

title: Captain Varron Maelor
summary: "Follow what he started or finish him."

title: The voice behind Vexhar's sigil
summary: It answered his ritual, branded his hand, calls him "little scholar" and urged his first zombie. Knowledge isn't free.

title: Blue and the Coral Court
summary: She escaped Lintri after ten years. Her father and brother are complicated. The party promised nobody will drag her back.

title: The cloaked patron
summary: "You've been chasing control rather than art. You'll learn another way." His fire will grow but always cost something.

title: Allyanna's pact with Solas
summary: A herald of Lathander made her false promises real. Solas went silent when she called for Francis.
